anchor: in not_judged, each with one sentence on why it is not the one tracked.
insert: When the outcome tracks a figure and also names one of these second sides of the same bet, the two are one bet seen from two sides, not several things with none the main one: ask the figure, and list that second side in not_judged. The second sides are: the share of the figure that one kind makes up; whether supply stays short of demand, or whether a shortage eases, beside a figure that measures that supply or its growth; and whether capacity keeps pace with the demand that figure measures. So a bank's total lending for the year, named together with the share that is commercial lending, is asked as the total lending, and a drug maker's total sales for the year, named together with the part its largest medicine makes up, are asked as the total sales; a steel mill's tonnes shipped in the year, named together with whether supply stays short of demand, are asked as the tonnes shipped, and a vaccine maker's new production capacity added in the year, named together with whether it comes soon enough to ease a shortage, is asked as the capacity added; a utility's power demand for the year, named together with whether its generating capacity keeps pace, is asked as the demand, and a port's container volume for the year, named together with whether its berths keep pace, is asked as the volume. When the outcome tracks the share itself, with the total only as its base, the share is the question: a bank's commercial share of its lending for the year is asked as that share, and a carmaker's electric share of the cars it sells in the year is asked as that share.
